description: What the signed-in member has open right now in Vela, our next-generation charting platform, in their browser, in words: the layout, and for each chart its market, timeframe, chart type, indicators, the dates on screen and its clock. Each indicator comes with the id vela_remove_indicators takes, and one that is a saved script of the member's also with its script_id, which quant_generate_pine_script changes it by. Use it before changing or drawing on the member's chart, and when they ask what their chart is set to. It changes nothing and carries no prices or candles; for a picture of the chart use chart_peek, and to show a chart inside the chat use chart_open. The member's Vela tab must be open and visible; a first ask after a quiet spell can say no chart is open, and asking again a minute later works. Requires signing in with a LuxAlgo account (OAuth).
